clues: Whoever went in by the scarecrow got through faster than whoever went in by the barn door.
Quinn's snack was not the kettle corn.
The friend who used the barn door finished in either 20 minutes or 30 minutes.
The friend who entered by the north gate had neither the kettle corn nor the donut.
Of the south gate friend and the 25-minute friend, one picked the donut and the other picked the kettle corn.
The 25-minute finisher picked either the donut or the candy apple.
Either Quinn or Jonah took 30 minutes.
The friend with the candy apple needed either 30 minutes or 35 minutes.
Quinn and Faye were, in some order, the 20-minute finisher and the 35-minute finisher.
hints: Look at 25 minutes in the box where times meet snacks. Which snack could the 25-minute friend have picked?
Two either-or clues meet here. Clue 7 allows the donut or the candy apple at 25 minutes. Clue 9 says where the candy apple can be.
So the 25-minute friend picked the donut. Then clue 6 gives the kettle corn to the south gate friend, who is someone else.
Clues 1 and 3 put the barn door at 30 minutes. The 25-minute donut was not the south gate or the north gate (clue 5), so it was the scarecrow.

solution.key_idea: Clues 7 and 9 put the donut at 25 minutes, and clue 6 then hands the kettle corn to the south gate.
steps: By clue 7, the 25-minute friend picked the donut or the candy apple. Clue 9 rules out the candy apple, so 25 minutes went with the donut.
By clue 6, the south gate friend did not take 25 minutes, so that friend picked the other snack of the pair: the kettle corn.
By clue 3, the barn door took 20 or 30 minutes. Clue 1 says the scarecrow was faster, so not 20. The barn door took 30 minutes.
The 25-minute donut friend did not use the barn door, the south gate, or the north gate (clue 5). So the scarecrow took 25 minutes.
By clue 10, Quinn and Faye took 20 and 35 minutes. Clue 4 keeps Quinn off 35, so Quinn took 20 and Faye 35.
By clue 8, Jonah took 30 minutes, so Hal took 25. So Jonah used the barn door, and Hal the scarecrow, with the donut.
Quinn did not pick the kettle corn (clue 2), so Quinn did not use the south gate. Quinn used the north gate, and Faye the south gate.
By clue 9, the candy apple took 30 or 35 minutes, and Faye's 35 had the kettle corn. So Jonah picked the candy apple, and Quinn the cider.
solution.epilogue: Quinn, in by the north gate, won in 20 minutes and toasted with cider, while Faye, last at 35, cheered up with kettle corn. Jonah, without his watch, guessed his 30 minutes exactly.
